description: Laravel 11+ enterprise development: Eloquent ORM relations and query scopes, Artisan console automation, asynchronous background Queues and Jobs, Livewire components, and Service Providers.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Laravel 11+ Enterprise Architecture & Domain Patterns

Build scalable, maintainable PHP web applications using modern Laravel 11 idioms.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Prevent N+1 query degradation by enforcing eager loading (`with()`) and `Model::preventLazyLoading()`.
- Encapsulate HTTP validation inside dedicated `FormRequest` classes.
- Design background Queue Jobs to be fully idempotent with explicit retry and backoff parameters.
- Register interface-to-implementation bindings cleanly inside dedicated `ServiceProvider`s.
